node.title: F2 weighted mass and heaviest-fiber sandwich
node.statement: For every finite-field linear syndrome map on the binary cube, let N(v) be its subset-syndrome fiber sizes, M=max_v N(v), and Z the weighted ternary kernel mass. Then M^2/2^m <= Z <= M. If the rank is d and a max-fiber estimate for this map gives M <= Lambda*(2^m/p^d)+E, then the identical bound holds for Z with no normalization loss. Thus a subexponential uniform binary full-agreement list-recovery bound pays the plus-branch and coupled minus-branch F2 mass terminals. Upstream def:q-row-atom concerns a different first-match residual family and requires an explicit map-and-owner transport before it can supply this estimate. No max-fiber, Q-flatness, transport, or prize bound is claimed.
